status: Working result with two scoped independent local reviews. Formal review pending.

conventions.normal_front: Order decreases into the bulk, endpoints 1 and 0. Added hypotheses are an anchored conversion front, constant passive order mobility M, no additional balance source or relative order flux, and corresponding material force mu times gradient chi. The accepted live S12 source is not added to relaxation. Constant near-incompressible density and area, monotone weak inward branch, mechanical pressure drop imposed across the local layer rather than far carrier EOS pressures. No chemical tilt of the equal-depth order wells or stored wave power was prescribed. Homogeneous ordered and disordered phases retain the adopted shear gate.
conventions.distributed_attachment: Energy density gains kp*w*(chi-chi0)²/2 tied to the normal rim location, w=sech²(z/(2 delta)), chi0=1/(1+exp(z/delta)), delta=sqrt(kappa/(2a)). The stiffness and template are illustrative. a=2, kappa=1, M=.4, kp=1.5, rho=2, area=3. Pressure shooting solves the steady order ODE and u, with zero pressure work from the fixed anchor. Delta p equals integral −mu*chi prime, plus negligible endpoint truncation errors. Normal force from translating the anchoring energy is checked against the pressure. Edge force is not counted a second time. Independent zero-current fixed-velocity material relaxation gives nu=(decay2-decay1)/(k2²-k1²)=M*kappa; sigma=kappa*integral(chi0 prime)². G0=rho² area nu/sigma. Steady nonzero-bias differential conductance is independently measured via two static pressure steps separated by .00005.
conventions.mixed_drives: New axisymmetric BVP runs at local heads corresponding to four signed drives, using prior ideal single-holder exterior and resting bulk W=0. Two distinct new head values per amplitude. Never imposes the current. Frozen local head is a counterexample to unqualified inference from far heads. This is not a matched brane–bulk moving solution. The translationally uniform flat layer supplies no sideways force. Speed-dependent dissipation, crowding, curvature, head loss in other parts, separate supports, and longitudinal phase matching require additional test data.
conventions.edge_front: Separate hypothesis: uniform material, thin front in four-dimensional material spanning a three-dimensional ball, only the two-sphere perimeter pinned in depth; small slopes and negligible other force, storage and dissipation in steady local normal balance. For equal density normal fluids, the order-only pressure jump is sigma*(−laplacian h) and u_n≈−nu*laplacian h. The fixed-edge formulas, first decay eigenvalue and compliant-edge control were independently derived analytically. The separate Wolfram checker did not finish, and its partial outputs are excluded as numerical corroboration. A fixed material-velocity relaxation or a quantitatively de-advected response is required. This is diffusive order relaxation, not the propagation speed of light. With a finite edge spring Bi=1, the fixed-edge interpretation of absolute center displacement/decay yields only 3/4 of true rate. For a smooth graph h=0 on edge, projected normal loading yields Fx=integral h*partial_x(dp), so no uniform-pressure lateral reaction. A prescribed gradient around a uniform fixed-edge cap gives Fx=g A(2/5)h0. This is neither a derived gradient from a companion nor full mouth force.
conventions.profile: Unit-radius archive with a flux proportional to (1−r²)^3, prescribed number current .25 in m=1 solver units. These saved files contain a carrier field and a current, not a measured conversion surface. Forward map archived current through the thin fixed-edge Poisson equation: center Green function (1/r−1)/(4 pi rho nu). The archive is treated as piecewise constant in each source voxel clipped to the unit ball, with two quadrature orders. The archived counts do not calibrate the independent physical mobility or impose a measured head.
conventions.publication_scope: The Allen–Cahn reference supplies an example of curvature-dependent relaxation in a material order boundary. Its coefficients and microscopic mechanisms are not imported as measurements of this model.

review.edge_verdict: Scoped clear for the thin-front, fixed-edge pressure–intake relation, its independent sag and fixed-material decay calibration, the elastic-edge and imposed-profile controls, and the normal-traction projection under a prescribed gradient. The physical local pressure, edge coupling, intrinsic relaxation and free-mouth response remain open.
review.report_verdict: Scoped clear for the pressure-driven stationary front, conditional equivalent-head intake response, and small-slope fixed-edge relations in the stated models. A physical reservoir-to-interface head transfer and companion-driven sideways force remain open.
review.planar_verdict: Scoped clear for pressure-driven intake, stationary anchor reaction, order dissipation and independent zero-head conductance calibration in the specified anchored planar front. The physical anchoring, mobility, head transfer, and sideways force of a draining mouth remain open.
